description: Inspect timestamped telemetry rows and start/end markers for one robot session.

targets.query: from(bucket: "robot-telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry" and r.session_id != "unassigned" and r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 500)

from(bucket: "robot-telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_session_events" and r.session_id =~ /^${session:regex}$/) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "session_id", "event_type", "label"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "robot-telemetry", tag: "session_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry" and r.session_id != "unassigned", start: -24h)
list.label: Session
list.name: session
